Logan — thanks for the context and the model. My guidance after quick margin play:

- Do NOT accept 20% for year 1. That leaves us negative on unit economics given the 10% customer discount they want.
- Counter (recommended):
  - Channel margin: 12% for year 1.
  - Customer discount: 10% off list at $300k ARR commit (12 months). 15% off list at $500k ARR commit.
  - Marketplace fees: Redwood will cover up to 2% of marketplace fees for year 1 only. Any excess must be passed through or negotiated separately with partner.
  - Term: 12 month minimum commit; auto-renew unless notice given 60 days prior.

Operational asks before signing:
- Sales ops to run final unit-econ table (Steph) and confirm overall CAC / payback.
- Legal to prepare SOW + private-offer docs with standard marketplace indemnities and a clause that channel margin is payable to the named partner on receipt of partner-signed invoice.

Rishi — if we want to be a bit more aggressive in exchange for a larger marketing co-op or a short-term credit, we can model a 14% margin at $500k commit. Thoughts?

Logan — if Acme wants to push 20%, push back with the tiered structure and emphasize Redwood covering initial fee friction to accelerate onboarding.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
